title: Interaction: Cinderheart × terrain / lifecycle
answer: Cinderheart × terrain / lifecycle: Vanilla explosion grief is always replaced. Terrain-disabled impacts mutate nothing; enabled servers receive at most eight policy-approved surface fires and no destroyed blocks. Death, disconnect, respawn, dimension change, power loss, suppression, time locks, expiry, unload, and shutdown discard both indexes and the ephemeral entity. Signature: Bounded flame sigils, individual scorch runes, or counter-coloured extinguishing heart.
